Afterglow browser edition

Authored application/bridge code: AGPL-3.0-only. Full license: LICENSE.txt.
Source: https://github.com/sbrunwas/afterglow/tree/main/web

The C++ drum core includes MIT-licensed DaisySP / Mutable Instruments Plaits drum models.
Their original copyright notices remain in src/core/third_party/DaisySP.
See DaisySP-LICENSE.txt for the MIT license text.

The browser build does not contain JUCE or a VST3 SDK runtime.
Independent project, unaffiliated with Roland, Reason Studios or Ableton.
909/808-inspired models; synthesized 909 cymbal approximations; no ROM samples bundled.
